intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.5.2; essential telemetry acquisition independent of the nominal on-board processing chain, across safe and contingency phases

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.5.2; aggregate essential-telemetry rate against the guaranteed emergency capacity, not the nominal downlink

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.6.14.3; the urgent latency depends on whether the unit waits for the queue, only for the unit in service, or interrupts it at a switch cost

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.6.11.4; a declared failure mode with no figure against it is unassessed rather than passing, so the whole assessment is open

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.6.14.2; guaranteed delivery means each unit arrives once and in order, so a duplicate breaks it and a reordering is separated from a loss

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.6.14.2; a bounded retry count is acceptable when the sender is notified, and the residual is the per-attempt loss compounded over the attempts

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.4.9; a command-activated chain is not receptive at the moment command authority is lost, so it does not count toward the hot total

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.7.1.6; a pair confined to one segment shares a single point of failure, and the outage is the whole chain, so the remedy is the detection time the budget leaves or a faster takeover

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.7.4.4; arrival is detection plus queueing plus propagation plus forwarding against the severity allowance, and an outage converts the requirement into rate times outage times record size

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C Rev.2 clause 5.6.4; cross-support compatibility is per attribute set intersection, and a single clashing attribute makes the partner unsupported

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.6.8; setup time is the sum of the stages before user data plus two propagation delays for every handshake exchange, compared with the declared budget

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C Rev.2 clause 5.6.6; noise sources only add at a common reference plane, and a lossy element both attenuates and generates

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.7.2.6; an exception nobody detects, one detected and never sent, one sent without enough to act on and one sent too late are four different rungs with four different owners

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.7.2.4; a resource is managed only when the service reaches it for every operation it is owed, so a node that reports state but cannot be configured or commanded is monitored rather than managed

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.7.1.3; each activation costs payload plus overhead plus guard, the busiest cycle sets the reservation, and the spare time is the whole asynchronous budget

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.4.8; per-stage verification coverage, with a rejection report and an absent report kept as different outcomes

intent: ECSS-E-ST-50C clause 5.4.8; stage deadline is uplink epoch plus round-trip light time plus the stage timeout, not the timeout alone
